description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Transistor (org.y20k.transistor), version 4.3.8.

features.name: Add a station by searching the radio-browser directory
features.description: Add a station by searching the radio-browser directory as documented for Transistor.
actions: tap the "+" icon in the top bar
tap a result from the radio-browser.info list
confirm to add it to the collection

features.name: Add a station from an M3U or PLS playlist address
features.description: Add a station from an M3U or PLS playlist address as documented for Transistor.
actions: Tap the "+" icon in the top bar
paste the playlist file address (.m3u or .pls) into the input field
tap the add/confirm button; the station name and image are read from the playlist

features.name: Add a station from a raw stream address
features.description: Add a station from a raw stream address as documented for Transistor.
actions: paste the direct stream URL (MP3, AAC or Ogg/Opus)
tap the add button; note that stations added this way cannot use the update feature

features.name: Add a station by opening a stream file in the browser
features.description: Add a station by opening a stream file in the browser as documented for Transistor.
actions: In a web browser tap a .m3u or .pls link
choose Transistor in the "Open with" chooser (or set it as the default handler for those file types)

features.name: Play a station
features.description: Play a station as documented for Transistor.
actions: tap the station (or its play button)
the stream starts and the player sheet appears at the bottom

features.name: Stop playback
features.description: Stop playback as documented for Transistor.
actions: Tap the stop button in the player sheet or in the notification, or disconnect the headphones according to the configured behaviour

features.name: View the now-playing metadata
features.description: View the now-playing metadata as documented for Transistor.
actions: read the station name and the currently reported track title where the stream provides it

features.name: Delete a station
features.description: Delete a station as documented for Transistor.
actions: the station is removed from the collection

features.name: Enable station editing
features.description: Enable station editing as documented for Transistor.

features.name: Rename a station
features.description: Rename a station as documented for Transistor.
actions: tap and hold the station in the list

features.name: Change a station's image
features.description: Change a station's image as documented for Transistor.
actions: pick an image from the device
confirm; the custom icon replaces the default one

features.name: Change a station's stream address
features.description: Change a station's stream address as documented for Transistor.

features.name: Update station information from the source
features.description: Update station information from the source as documented for Transistor.
actions: Transistor re-reads the playlist source to refresh the stream address, name and image (this does not work for stations added by raw stream address)

features.name: Reorder stations in the list
features.description: Reorder stations in the list as documented for Transistor.
actions: drag it to the required position

features.name: Set a sleep timer
features.description: Set a sleep timer as documented for Transistor.
actions: tap it again to cancel or extend it

features.name: Control playback from the notification
features.description: Control playback from the notification as documented for Transistor.
actions: use the play/stop control shown in the media notification

features.name: Add a home screen shortcut for a station
features.description: Add a home screen shortcut for a station as documented for Transistor.
actions: tap the "Add shortcut"/place on home screen action
confirm; tapping the shortcut starts that station directly

features.name: Import stations by copying M3U files into the collection folder
features.description: Import stations by copying M3U files into the collection folder as documented for Transistor.
actions: Connect the device to a computer (or use a file manager)
reopen the app; the stations appear in the list

features.name: Back up and restore the station collection
features.description: Back up and restore the station collection as documented for Transistor.
actions: Copy the Collection folder from /Android/data/org.y20k.transistor/files/ to a safe location; restore it by copying the folder back before opening the app. On devices with Android auto-backup enabled the collection is backed up with the account automatically

features.name: Choose the playback behaviour on Bluetooth/headphone disconnect
features.description: Choose the playback behaviour on Bluetooth/headphone disconnect as documented for Transistor.
actions: set whether playback stops when the audio device is disconnected

features.name: Change the theme
features.description: Change the theme as documented for Transistor.
actions: choose light, dark or the system default

features.name: Delete all stations (reset the collection)
features.description: Delete all stations (reset the collection) as documented for Transistor.
actions: confirm; all stations are removed from the list

features.name: View the about screen and licence information
features.description: View the about screen and licence information as documented for Transistor.
actions: read the app version, the radio-browser.info attribution and the MIT licence information. ## **Category: Security and utility**
